@graph.d3f:definition: Collects information on applications on an endpoint.
@graph.rdfs:label: Application Inventory Sensor

@graph.d3f:definition: Senses data from cloud service platforms. Including data from cloud service  authentications, authorizations, and other activities.
@graph.rdfs:label: Cloud Service Sensor

@graph.d3f:definition: A sensor application installed on a endpoint (platform) to collect information on platform components.
@graph.rdfs:label: Endpoint Sensor

@graph.d3f:definition: Collects files and file metadata on an endpoint.
@graph.rdfs:label: File System Sensor

@graph.d3f:definition: Collects information on firmware installed on an Endpoint.
@graph.rdfs:label: Firmware Sensor

@graph.d3f:definition: Collects the configuration data on an endpoint.
@graph.rdfs:label: Host Configuration Sensor

@graph.d3f:definition: Monitors system calls (operating system api functions).
@graph.rdfs:label: Kernel API Sensor

@graph.d3f:definition: Monitors network traffic and produces summaries of data flows traversing the network.
@graph.rdfs:label: Network Flow Sensor

@graph.d3f:definition: Monitors and parses network protocols to extract values from various network protocol layers.
@graph.rdfs:label: Network Protocol Analyzer

@graph.d3f:definition: A network scanner is a computer program used to retrieve usernames and info on groups, shares, and services of networked computers. This type of program scans networks for vulnerabilities in the security of that network. If there is a vulnerability with the security of the network, it will send a report back to a hacker who may use this info to exploit that network glitch to gain entry to the network or for other malicious activities. Ethical hackers often also use the information to remove the glitches and strengthen their network.
@graph.rdfs:label: Network Scanner

@graph.d3f:definition: An OT Sensor is an industrial-grade sensing device engineered for operational technology (OT) environments (e.g. SCADA, ICS). It measures physical variables—such as pressure, temperature, or flow—under demanding conditions, converting them into reliable signals for real-time monitoring and process control loops.
@graph.rdfs:label: OT Sensor
